Today is the 59th anniversary of the most effective anti-hunger initiative in U.S. history: the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program!

As a member of @houseagdems, I'm fighting to #DefendSNAP for the 730,000 Oregonians who rely on it to feed themselves & their families.

McCarthy’s decision to open an unfounded impeachment inquiry into President Biden is nothing more than partisan politics at its worst. This wasteful, baseless exercise is a distraction that will hamper our ability to work on the issues that really matter to working Oregonians.

That's why I'm proud to cosponsor the Community Mental Wellness and Resilience Act.
 
This legislation takes a community-oriented approach to mental health care, investing in more social supports and resilience skill building.

The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is a federal resource that can help with buying groceries & necessities ➡️https://t.co/VzuPFt515I
 
Marion Polk Food Share➡️https://t.co/RNXo5F35mM

YCAP has 17 food bank locations, including in #OR06 ➡️ https://t.co/L92e3sfMXa
From exercise classes to meal services, the Wilsonville Community Center offers seniors the support and resources to thrive in their everyday lives. https://t.co/fwrybIRG4G

If you or a loved one is experiencing food insecurity, you may be eligible for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program—better known as SNAP.

Click the link to learn more ⬇️
https://t.co/tnYrLkrxVp

October is Emotional Wellness Month. As Co-Chair of the bipartisan Mental Health Caucus, I am dedicated to ending the stigma around mental health – and I’ll keep working to make care more accessible and affordable for Oregonians.
#EmotionalWellnessMonth https://t.co/erFFGdzT5F

Black Americans are 20% more likely to experience significant mental health challenges, yet only 1 in 3 Black adults seek treatment for their symptoms.

We must work together to reduce the stigma & connect all Americans with the care they deserve.

Visit the link below for mental health tips & resources for members of the Black community 👇
https://t.co/YLR3az5MYg

The Trump Administration lied to veterans, saying $2 billion in planned cuts were simply "consulting deals."

The truth? Cancer care, toxic exposure treatment, and disability benefits for veterans were all on the chopping block.

https://t.co/b6HYtd7AMq

Getting a restful night's sleep is essential to our physical and emotional wellbeing.

Click the link below to learn more about how to improve your sleep 👇😴 #MentalHealthMonday

https://t.co/ElbgmdrkKD

Having a baby can bring up a whole host of emotions for new moms, including some unexpected ones like sadness & anxiety.

That's why it's important to know the signs & symptoms of postpartum depression. Click the link to learn more 👇 #MentalHealthMonday https://t.co/WDcRk2GthY

I visited Bridgeway Community Health in #Salem, where I learned all about their mission & ongoing challenges like capacity issues.

I just introduced a bill in Congress to address this problem & connect more patients with treatment.

Watch to learn more 🎧👇 https://t.co/NqmGZF081x

Are you getting enough H2O? 🚰💧

Research shows that if we don't drink enough water, our bodies produce more of the stress hormone cortisol.

Take a moment to drink water & learn about the link between hydration & mental wellbeing. #MentalHealthMonday ⬇️ https://t.co/pMCjja2VLS

Receiving a life changing diagnosis like Parkinson's disease can take a toll on your mental health.

Here are some helpful tips on how to manage stress & care for your emotional wellbeing while living with Parkinson's disease. #MentalHealthMonday

https://t.co/DRfRDDEqfM

For the first time in 6 years, drug overdose deaths decreased in the United States, and now President Trump and his Administration want to gut Medicaid, which is a vital source of funding for opioid and fentanyl addiction treatment. Funding that saves lives.
🔗 https://t.co/gSPJWQMFcI

Know that you are never alone. There is always hope and help 💚

Please call 9-8-8 for help or visit https://t.co/iiBLcPvT3G to find more mental health and substance abuse treatment and recovery resources. (2/2)

Most American women go through menopause between the ages of 45 and 58.

If you have symptoms, talk to your provider about menopausal relief & care. To learn more about menopause, visit https://t.co/0Rah1GAvSw.

#NationalWomensHealthWeek 💜 🩺

This Republican budget bill is both cruel and inhumane.

With integrated medical, dental, and pharmacy services on site, this new facility will help the clinic provide quality, affordable health care to even more Oregonians. (3/3) https://t.co/hQd2kNBk0M

The Republican Tax Scam ends critical health care services like cancer screenings and wellness exams for women who use Planned Parenthood.

Our mothers, daughters, and neighbors will suffer all at the cost of giving tax breaks to billionaires.

Last month, I toured Virginia Garcia’s new #Newberg Wellness Center. Their expanded facility will increase the organization’s capacity to deliver affordable dental, pharmacy, and primary care to patients across #Yamhill County.
🔗 https://t.co/o5ADAilBup

I stood with @RonWyden & @RepDexterOR to call out Republicans’ Big, Ugly Bill, which blocks OHP (Medicaid) payments to @PPFA for a year.

The reality is that 60% of @PPFA patients in #OR rely on OHP for vital services like cancer screenings.

This is an all-out attack on women, and I'll fight back until they have full access to the health care they deserve.

We've all experienced that moment when we've been on our phones a little more than we'd like to admit.

Too much screen time can even lead to eye strain, disrupted sleep, & even depression & anxiety.

Click the link below to learn about 7 tips to managing your screen time ⬇️ #MentalHealthMonday

https://t.co/IHbHWJi7vw

Yesterday, I toured #Aumsville Clinic to speak directly with the providers and patients on the front lines in our rural communities.

Medicare and Medicaid cover countless rural patients. Republicans’ cuts could shutter rural clinics like this one, leaving Oregonians with nowhere else to turn.
